claim.purpose: Prepare #5332 for bounded v0.91.8 WP-15 Unity ILPP GetDomainName loop diagnosis and regression execution

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Classify and fix Unity ILPP GetDomainName loop in observatory batch proof
initial.goal: Reproduce, isolate, and fix the Unity ILPP GetDomainName retry loop while preserving normal Observatory batch proof behavior.
initial.required_outcome: A focused classifier detects the complete ILPP non-progress loop quickly, a controlled matrix identifies the root cause or exact irreducible blocker, and regression proof preserves successful Unity batch validation.
declared_scope: Progress-aware repetition threshold and reset behavior
Controlled Unity, host/domain, HOME/TMP/XDG, and wrapper-staging diagnostic matrix
Focused no-Unity fixtures and one safe staged reproduction
Root-cause fix limited to the proven owner surface
authority_boundary: #5332 owns ILPP GetDomainName loop classification, diagnosis, and proven root-cause fix
#4741 owns editor liveness, execution-mode selection, general staging, and watchdog behavior
#4739 owns Unity-MCP project and endpoint alignment
No scene generation, fallback geometry, runtime contract semantics, asset publication, investor rendering, or walkthrough capture
No arbitrary total runtime ceiling, broad process scan, /private/tmp staging, scratch owner binaries, or secret-bearing environment dump
initial.task_boundary: Implement only the ILPP loop classifier, controlled diagnosis, and proven root-cause repair on the current v0.91.8 base.
deliverables: Reusable ILPP and progress classifier surface
Controlled environment-matrix runner or retained command packet
Minimal proven root-cause fix or exact blocker disposition
Operator diagnosis note with ownership routing
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: the complete connectivity, gRPC or type-initialization, and GetDomainName -1 signature family is reproducible in one approved staged proof or retained fixture derived from exact evidence
AC-2: repeated complete signatures without semantic progress classify as ilpp_retry_loop without waiting for an arbitrary total runtime ceiling
AC-3: import, compile, validator, or terminal progress resets the non-progress classifier and preserves successful batch behavior
AC-4: readonly-database text remains a separate classifier and is not fatal after verified staged import progress
AC-5: the controlled matrix distinguishes wrapper staging, mutable HOME TMP XDG isolation, host or domain identity, and Unity version with one variable changed per cell
AC-6: each matrix cell retains Unity version, canonical staged project, non-secret environment shape, semantic progress markers, signature count, terminal classification, and log reference
AC-7: the minimal root-cause fix is applied only after the matrix isolates its owner; otherwise the exact current blocker and owner are recorded
AC-8: focused no-Unity tests cover incomplete signature, complete repeating loop, progress reset, readonly progression, and normal ILPP start
AC-9: one safe staged regression reaches the existing Observatory validator success marker or records a precise post-ILPP blocker without claiming full demo readiness
AC-10: the final diff excludes #4739 MCP internals, #4741 general liveness and mode selection, Unity scene code, runtime semantics, asset work, and rendering polish
dependencies: #4741 safe fresh_batch mode or equivalent exact staged-project ownership proof
WP-15 #5354 consumes the final proof or exact blocker
repo_inputs: retained ILPP GetDomainName error family from #4741
non_goals: Do not redesign Unity proof-mode selection
Do not repair Unity-MCP endpoint alignment
Do not modify Unity scene builder or validator semantics
Do not add asset fallback or investor-facing polish
Do not build owner binaries or use /private/tmp
Do not dump complete environment or host process state
initial.plan_summary: Extract the ILPP classifier, prove it with deterministic fixtures, reproduce through #4741 safe staging, run a one-variable diagnostic matrix, apply only the isolated root-cause fix, and prove normal batch behavior.

steps.action: Extract a focused progress-aware ILPP signature classifier and deterministic fixture harness
Use #4741 safe staging to reproduce the loop and retain exact non-secret baseline evidence
Run the smallest one-variable environment matrix needed to isolate wrapper, mutable state, host/domain identity, or Unity version
Apply the minimal isolated root-cause fix or record the exact irreducible blocker and owner
Run focused fixtures and one safe normal-start regression, then record bounded review and WP-15 outcome truth

risks: Repeating ILPP logs can appear live while no semantic progress occurs
Changing multiple environment variables at once could produce a false root-cause attribution
A Unity version comparison can introduce unrelated import differences
The general wrapper overlaps #4741 and must remain narrowly partitioned
Host and domain evidence can leak machine-specific detail unless bounded
invariants: Only complete repeating ILPP signatures classify the loop
One diagnostic variable changes per matrix cell
The root-cause fix follows evidence rather than speculation
Repository binaries and approved staging remain authoritative
stop_conditions: #4741 cannot provide a safe staged-project mode
The loop cannot be reproduced from exact retained evidence or an approved staged run
Diagnosis requires broad host inspection or secret-bearing environment output
More than one matrix variable must change in a cell
The isolated fix belongs to #4739, #4741, Unity scene code, or another owner
review_prompts: Does the classifier require the complete ILPP signature family and reset on real progress?
Does the matrix vary one cause at a time and retain enough evidence to support attribution?
Is readonly-database handling independent and progress-aware?
Does the normal-start regression prove the classifier does not break successful Unity proof?
Is the final diff limited to #5332 ownership?
operator_constraints: Work only in the issue-bound v0.91.8 execution-preparation worktree
Preserve the earlier #5332 preparation branch and dirty #4739/#4741 predecessor worktrees
Use /Volumes/FastWork or issue-local .adl for staging and repository-installed binaries only
No arbitrary total runtime ceiling, /private/tmp, broad process scans, raw gh fallback, or secret exposure

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove complete-signature classification, semantic progress reset, readonly progression, and normal-start behavior without Unity
Reproduce or clear the ILPP loop in one #4741-approved staged batch mode
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run only after #4741 provides exact safe staged-project ownership and the deterministic classifier lane passes.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Retain one-variable environment comparisons that isolate the ILPP failure owner
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Execute only the cells still required after the baseline reproduction; do not run redundant Unity comparisons.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove bounded text and shell hygiene

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on incomplete signature attribution, arbitrary total-runtime ceilings, multi-variable diagnosis, unsafe staging, secret-bearing host evidence, adjacent Unity scope, or unsupported root-cause and readiness claims.
